title: test_requirements
description: Schema for the test_requirements block produced by the test-planner agent and embedded in ticket bodies, AND for the ## Test Requirements descriptor list generate_ticket_from_ac.py emits. Version 2.0.0 (BO-2900g-3) reconciles this schema's former 'type' enum (unit/integration/manual/live_dispatch), which muddled test LEVEL with one kind-of-proof value, with config/ac_store_schema.json's test_spec[].angle enum — the kind-of-proof axis — into ONE permitted-kind vocabulary, carried here as 'angle' — see docs/reference/required-proof-vocabulary.md. 'live_dispatch' is RETIRED; the reached-the-real-way kind is now named 'reachability' (the test-angle taxonomy's name), with no synonym accepted. The entry-point fact survives under the field name the retiring definition already used ('asserts' on the generator's emitted descriptor carries the same fact — see the description below). 'type' is NOT part of the reconciled kind-of-proof vocabulary: generate_ticket_from_ac.py's _test_descriptors_from_spec copies the AC's test_spec[].type straight through as a separate key, so an emitted descriptor's 'type' carries the test-LEVEL value (unit/integration/e2e/behavioral) from config/ac_store_schema.json's test_spec[].type — the orthogonal, out-of-scope axis — never a kind-of-proof value.

rationale.description: One-sentence explanation of why tests are needed, or why the tests array is empty.

tests.description: Ordered list of test specifications. May be empty for docs-only or config-only tickets.

test_entry.description: One descriptor in a ticket's ## Test Requirements 'tests:' list, on EITHER planning route (criteria-derived fallback or authored test_spec) — see scripts/ac_store/generate_ticket_from_ac.py. Only name/file/covers are guaranteed present on every route; angle/type/asserts/framework/requires_db are present when the producing route supplies them.

name.description: Test file or function name. Must start with 'test_' per naming_pattern convention.

file.description: Repo-relative path to the test file this descriptor's test lives (or should live) in.

angle.description: BO-2900g-3 RECONCILED KIND ENUM: which proof-of-done question this test answers, from the test-angle taxonomy in docs/testing/test-angles.md. The single vocabulary shared with 'type' below and with config/ac_store_schema.json's test_spec[].type/.angle enums (docs/reference/required-proof-vocabulary.md). The retired ticket-facing kind 'live_dispatch' is gone with no synonym; its meaning is now 'reachability'.

type.description: Test level. Guides where the test runs and how heavy its fixtures are. Orthogonal to 'angle' (the kind-of-proof axis) and NOT part of the BO-2900g-3 reconciliation — mirrors config/ac_store_schema.json's test_spec[].type enum, which generate_ticket_from_ac.py copies through verbatim onto this key. `component` is a rendered-in-isolation UI test, neither unit nor end-to-end.

description.description: One sentence describing the observable behavior this test verifies.

asserts.description: What this test asserts. On a reachability-kind entry (angle == 'reachability') this is the entry-point fact: either the author's own named production entry point (CLI, hook, slash command, agent) carried through verbatim, or the single stable 'entry point is not declared' sentinel — a CONFORMING value, not a violation (BO-2900g-1-i, BO-2900g-4).

framework.description: Test framework, copied through verbatim from config/ac_store_schema.json's test_spec[].framework by generate_ticket_from_ac.py. MUST be kept identical to that enum: a value legal there and not here produces a generated ticket that violates its own schema, and because nothing enforces this schema that failure would be silent rather than loud. unit_tests/ac_store/test_test_spec_framework_vocabulary.py holds the two in step.

target_dir.description: Repo-relative directory the test file lives in — the authoring-facing counterpart of 'file' (config/ac_store_schema.json's test_spec[].target_dir).

surface_invoked.description: Alternate name for the reachability entry-point fact carried in 'asserts' (kept for authoring surfaces that name the field this way; see config/ac_store_schema.json's test_spec[].surface_invoked).
